title: load() randomly skips applying fetched tasks
summary: After fetching, load() returns early about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5) before applying the tasks or clearing loading, so the UI intermittently stays on "Loading…" or shows stale data. The test and the rest of the app logic are correct; the failure is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.

expectedFailure.testTitle: empty board shows the empty state
